navigation.question: What navigation methods do your mobile robots support?
navigation.answer: Our mobile robots support multiple navigation methods including laser SLAM, visual navigation, QR code navigation, etc. They can be flexibly configured according to customer site environments to meet diverse application needs.

development.question: Does the robot control system support secondary development and system integration?
development.answer: Yes. We provide open SDK and API for customers to facilitate secondary development and integration with third-party systems, helping to achieve personalized function expansion.

customization.question: Can robots or systems be customized according to customer requirements?
customization.answer: Yes. We support custom software and hardware development, including structure, functions, interfaces and other aspects. Please contact us to discuss specific requirements.

about.companyIntro: ZeroAnt Technology is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of micro-logistics intelligent conveying systems. We are committed to connecting professional equipment and application scenarios through innovative intelligent logistics solutions, helping various industries achieve efficient and reliable intelligent upgrades. Our core team consists of researchers from Beihang University and industry experts, with profound technical expertise and rich engineering experience.

companyIntroDetailed.para1: Hangzhou ZeroAnt Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise founded by the research team from Beihang University Hangzhou Innovation Research Institute, focusing on the R&D of intelligent robot complete solutions. Currently, it provides highly reliable robot intelligent system solutions for biopharmaceutical, semiconductor and other industries.
companyIntroDetailed.para2: The company relies on the Zhejiang Provincial Key Laboratory of Industrial Big Data and Robot Intelligent Systems, independently developing the "Intelligent Robot Operating System" (AiROS), conquering core technologies such as mobile robot autonomous navigation, high-speed and high-precision control of robotic arms, 3D spatial semantic perception, and multi-robot collaborative scheduling, creating a full-stack software ecosystem and modular hardware platform.
companyIntroDetailed.para3: The team has established normalized cooperation mechanisms with multiple top domestic institutions, forming a closed-loop innovation system of "industry-university-research-application". As a pioneer of industrial intelligent infrastructure, ZeroAnt Technology is promoting industry intelligent upgrades with fully autonomous and controllable technology, continuously empowering high-quality development of the manufacturing industry.
companyIntroDetailed.financingDesc: The team is currently in the angel round financing stage. If you are interested in the team or have cooperation intentions, please contact us by email. Startup teams value time, no casual inquiries please!

about.culture: Practical application, Integrity and honesty, Pragmatic development, Agile iteration
